clock: trusted root controller wall clock around each request round trip: request-specific allocation, cache initialization, all model evaluations, token selection, state reset, result validation, device-to-host transfer and response serialization
deadline: Identical outer timeout per complete evaluation; terminal resume preserves its root deadline, while each interactive (original round_id, submission_id) has an independent root-only checkpoint subdirectory and a deadline written once.
fresh_process: Same row-atomic unprivileged worker lifecycle and controller memory/quality gates for every scored round
measurement_profile_role: recorded provenance of the reference producer run and of every scored run; driver_version and the image ids never select or refuse a quality reference
memory: device-relative cap evaluated on the Judge device; headroom and safety margin from the frozen memory policy
quality_reference: producer reference regenerated once per reference profile (scripts/calibrate_reference.py, cached under private_data/reference_cache/<reference_profile_key>.json and installed by scripts/select_reference_profile.py); the Judge refuses a reference of another GPU model / compute capability or a Judge whose software ABI differs from the one the references were measured under; a host driver change or an image rebuild with unchanged software keeps the reference
row_aggregation: sum(useful tokens) / sum(timed seconds) per row; geometric mean over rows
timed_scope: generation only; checkpoint and tokenizer load, prompt tokenization, warm-up, trusted text decode, answer parsing and tests are untimed
